Strong depth perspective and standing conversation around CART not table, evening warm side light, restrained palette. CAMERA EMPHASIS: close oblique view from beside the loaded handcart; its broad wooden wheel and cloth bolts dominate lower right foreground, leading diagonally into lane. In near foreground center, mediator's outstretched purse and merchant's open refusing palm are clearly separated silhouettes against lighter awning; include faces higher up but do not arrange four adults in an equal straight frontal row. Receiver farther down the lane; second merchant behind cart. Avoid static frontal group portrait.
